Hard rules

2. Never invent a character. If it is not clearly visible, use state NOT_OBSERVABLE. If visible but ambiguous, use UNCERTAIN.
3. NOT_OBSERVABLE is not ABSENT. Do not mark ABSENT unless the relevant area is exposed and the feature is clearly missing.

CHR_01.reason: Dark microgranular test wall visible in thin section.

CHR_02.reason: Overall test outline is distinctly elongate and tapered.

CHR_03.reason: Distinct transverse septa clearly visible separating chambers.

CHR_04.reason: Test consists of numerous organized chambers.

CHR_05.reason: Initial portion is multiserial/triserial transitioning to uniserial.

CHR_06.reason: Test grows linearly along an axial axis without spiral coiling.

CHR_09.reason: Early stage shows triserial chamber arrangement followed by uniserial adult stage.

CHR_10.reason: Chambers appear simple and undivided internally.

CHR_11.reason: No secondary chamberlets observed inside chambers.

CHR_13.reason: No internal radial or vertical partitions observed.

CHR_16.reason: Apertural region located at the distal apex, though exact orifice structure is unclear.

CHR_17.reason: Marginal cord absent in this wall structure.

CHR_19.reason: Test shape suggests free-living benthic mode of life.

CHR_20.reason: Single specimen view does not allow assessment of dimorphism.

CHR_21.reason: Section is cut along the longitudinal axis passing through sequential chambers.

candidate_genera.name: Clavulina
candidate_genera.why: Elongate microgranular agglutinated test with early triserial stage becoming uniserial.

candidate_genera.name: Pseudoclavulina
candidate_genera.why: Morphologically similar triserial to uniserial agglutinated test.

vlm_suggestion.why_not_species_level: Detailed aperture wall layer and exact chamber internal morphology cannot be fully established from a single thin section view.

observation.student_explanation_en: This thin section shows an elongate, agglutinated foraminifer with a dark microgranular wall. The early portion shows chambers arranged in three rows (triserial), which then transitions into single wide chambers (uniserial). This ontogenetic pattern (triserial-to-uniserial) is characteristic of genera such as Clavulina.
observation.student_explanation_tr: Bu İnce kesitte koyu renkli mikrogranüler (aglütine) kavkı yapısına sahip uzamış bir foraminifer görülmektedir. Erken evrede kamaralar üçlü dizilim gösterirken (triseriyal), ilerleyen evrede tekli dizilime (uniseriyal) geçmektedir. Bu triseriyalden uniseriyale geçiş gösteren gelişim paterni Clavulina gibi cinslerin tipik özelliğidir.
expert_checklist_tr: Kavkı duvarının aglütine yapısı yüksek büyütmede teyit edilmeli.
Erken triseriyal evrenin kamara düzeni daha detaylı incelenmeli.
Apertürün dişli (tooth) yapısının varlığı kontrol edilmeli.
Uniseriyal kamaraların iç bölmesiz basit yapıda olduğu doğrulanmalı.
observation.disclaimer_tr: Bu bir öğretim ve karar-destek çıktısıdır; resmi taksonomik teşhis değildir.
